programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Evil Intent : Drops of blood and a torn screen were all that's left to tell authorities what happened to a woman in Indiana. The 21 yr. old victim was taken from her home on a spring morning. She appeared to have no real enemies, there was no clear motive.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Terror For Sale : In the 1980s the drug trade ravaged Chicago's inner city neighborhoods. Heroin and cocaine sales soared. Violent crime threatened to destroy the community.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Hidden Agenda : Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Death in Alaska : The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Without Remorse : A small town without any crime was turned inside out by the arrival of one dangerous stranger. Some killers are cold and calculating; others are impulsive, unpredictable, and hard to pin down.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Betrayed : On the day before Thanksgiving, a mother discovered her ten-year-old son was missing from his school. When a child of separated parents disappears, investigators first look at the family and divorced parents often suspect each other.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Death of A Diplomat : In the 1970's South America faced a surge of political kidnappings and assassinations. When the killings spilled onto U.S. soil it was time for the FBI to step in.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Operation Seaload : When the streets of New York flooded with crack cocaine in the 1980's a wave of violence threatened to drown the city. Colombian cartels brought the coke in and ran their operations with an iron fist.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped : On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Tracks of a Killer : From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: The Shootist : In the late 1980s the FBI matched wits with a cunning bank robber, a lone gunman responsible for the longest string of unsolved bank robberies in FBI history.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Radical Agenda : In the 1970's a string of bank robberies and bombings spread fear and destruction along the east coast. The FBI faced a new breed of criminal, the domestic terrorist.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Without Mercy : Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Operation Goldenrod : In the 1980s, the United States faced a deadly new enemy abroad, an expanding network of terrorists targeting American interests. Hundreds of innocent people were killed in bombings, executions, and hijackings.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Stolen Identity : In the United States, identity theft costs citizens billions of dollars. In some cases, it costs the lives of innocent people.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Death Pact : The average bank robbery yields roughly 3,000 dollars. Yet some criminals risk everything for the take. In suburban Chicago, a disguised gunman began a series of robberies, growing more violent with each one.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Crime Spree : They swept through six states like a plague, thrill killers acting without rhyme or reason. They targeted adults and young girls, kidnapping, and murdering. And in their rampage, they left plenty of clues, but moving targets are the hardest to hit.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Double Helix : DNA Analysis: With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Out Of The Grave : New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Remnant of Blame : The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Price of Murder : Using science as their most powerful weapon, investigators must find these hired killers and make them pay the true price of murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Grave Discoveries : Some cases simply can't be solved with current technology or with the evidence at hand. But that doesn't mean they'll remain unsolved forever.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Blood Money : Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Tools Of Death : Tool marking: A tool used to commit a crime can often be the same tool used to solve it. The pattern a machine leaves on an item, the unusual way a tool crimps a wire, and even something as innocuous as the shape of a wood chip can lead to a killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Broken Vows : When lovers turn on each other, or marriages fail, some ruthless spouses find a grisly way to gain an uncontested divorce with no paperwork. When murder tears lovers apart, forensic science must put piece together the mystery to catch the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Loved To Death : A victim usually never foresees danger when the perpetrator turns out to be a friend or a lover. Science and microscopic evidence can unmask these killers and find justice for those who are Loved To Death.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Fatal Abduction : Anytime, anywhere, people disappear, kidnapped from their daily routines. Predators always leave clues behind, but chasing them takes time, hampering investigators' attempts to solve these fatal abductions.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Left At The Scene : The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Blind Trust : A woman's body is found and investigators have little time and few clues to lead them to a killer who could strike again. Perpetrators try to conceal their crimes, yet savvy investigators can take the most obscure data and recreate a murder.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Lethal Dosage : Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Natural Witness : The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Lethal Obsessions : Some people will let nothing stand between them and their goals. In their tortured minds, raw desire replaces all reason, and homicide becomes a convenient means to an end.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Toxic Death : Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: Rainbows To The Rescue/Daydreams Come True : When flight magic disappears from Zahramay Skies, Rubi and the girls try to set things right, using rainbows to get around. When Zeta combines Daydream Dust with Dream Come True Dust, genies' daydreams start coming true and wreaking havoc.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: The Painting Gem/Longest Day Ever : When Zeta gets hold of a magical painting gem, she creates lots of troublesome art that the girls must get under control. When Leah accidentally wishes for the day to last forever, the kids must find a way to make the moon come up to end the day.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine
programme.desc: The Zahracorn Salon/Zahracorn Tickles : The girls partake in a Zahracorn Race. Zeta and Nazboo enter with a tiny, speedy Zahracorn named Tickles. The girls take Adara's Zahracorn to the salon, but must track her down when she gets spooked by all the salon magic.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: The Flutter Blunder/A Striking Surprise : When Nella's messenger falcon Flutter mishears her dictating the invitations to Clod's Birthday Party, she delivers some very confusing messages to her guests. Chaos ensues on the day of the Castlehaven bowling tournament!

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: The Sparkle Fest Showdown/The Sparkle Splash Friends Day : Going up against Clod for the Sparkle Fest Championship brings out Trinket's competitive side. Nella has organized a day at the Sparkle Splash Playspace for her friends, but then a mysterious pink mist invades the kingdom.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: That's What Best Friends Are For/In Hot Watermelon : It's the day of a big parade, and Trinket refuses to admit that she is ill. Willow is convinced to enter a gardening contest - and accidentally creates an enormous runaway watermelon.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Sir Coach's Knightly Trading Card/A Knight's Tale : When Nella and Garrett accidentally ruin Sir Coach's favorite trading card, they go on a quest to make him a new one. A celebrity knight visits Castlehaven – and so does the fearsome dragon he supposedly defeated.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: No Gown, No Crown, No Party/Clod Monet : Olivia convinces Minatori that she must kiss a frog to attend a fancy tea party. Clod lovingly paints pictures of Trinket for the Castlehaven Art Faire - but she doesn't like them!

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: The Share Faire/Hooves Got Talent? : Blaine becomes jealous of Nella at their school's craft fair. After entering a talent show, Clod is embarrassed to discover that he doesn't have the same talent as all the other horses.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Three's a Crowd/More Than Meets the Eye : Trinket gets jealous when Nella spends time with Minatori at the mall. Nella and Trinket are performing ballet when a near-sighted cyclops crashes their recital.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Royally Awesome Beach Day/Stop Dragon Me Around : Sea Dragons threaten to spoil Castlehaven's Beach Day. During a scavenger hunt, Smelgly is paired with Olivia, who takes advantage of their new friendship.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Of Critters and Dragons/Carriages, Carts and Giantmobiles : Nella brings some wild critters to school for show-and-tell, but things soon get out of control. Two rock giant brothers have a disagreement, leaving Nella's family carriage stranded on top of their bridge.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Sir Coach's Quest/The Dragon Knight : When Sir Coach embarks on a dangerous quest, Nella tags along and realizes she still has a lot to learn. Nella helps Smelgly the dragon fulfill her dream of joining the Knight Brigade.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Princess Nella's Perfect Family Picture/Giant Trouble : Trinket is desperate to keep things perfect for Royal Family Picture Day. Nella and Norma's 'Best Sisters' playdate is interrupted by two arguing rock giant brothers.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Dueling Sleepovers/The Great Doodle Star : Nella and Trinket accidently agree to attend both Garrett and Minatori's sleepovers on the same night. Garrett and Blaine disobey the rules and sneak out at night to see a fantastical star.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: The Fanciest of Them All/Practice Makes Progress : Blaine's fancy cousin Olivia visits and questions Nella's ability to be both a princess and a knight. When Nella loses a knightly contest, she's determined to improve by practicing.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: The Knight Before Christmas : It's Christmas Eve in Castlehaven and Santa visits the kingdom. When snow dragons steal his bag of presents, It's up to Nella and her friends to track down the creatures and return the list time for Santa to make his deliveries.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Let It Snow/Go Dragondaisies! Go! : Nella searches for a magical crystal to make it snow for their annual "Snow Festival." Nella and her friends must play as a team to win the Castlehaven gobletball tournament.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: The Halloween Hippogriff/King Gork the First : Blaine sets out to give everyone a fright at Nella's big Halloween party. Gork has a little too much fun when he's declared King for the Day.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Sir Blaine's Quest for Badges/Trinket's Big Break : While camping with the Knight Trekkers, Blaine goes to extreme lengths to earn his first badge. Nella finally brings two arguing groups of dragons together, but Trinket accidentally reignites their rivalry.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Nella vs. The Wicked Wizard : Nella bravely journeys to track down a wicked wizard, who has taken all of the kingdom's fancy things. But she has to rely on her own inner courage after he takes her knightly heart pendant too!

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Trink On The Rink/The Brave Dragon : Trinket is hesitant to enter the Castlehaven Rollerfest until she discovers a pair of "magical" roller skates. Blaine gets jealous when Garrett is cast as the part he wants in the big school play.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Flutter 2.0/Triple Play : Flutter gets jealous when Nella asks Flapper to deliver her mail. Nella must teach three hydra sisters how to take turns before they ruin this year's Harvest Festival.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Surf's Down/One Giant Journey : A selfish giant takes all of the kingdom's water for himself. When Nella and the gang run out of lemons for their lemonade stand, they embark on a journey of epic proportions to find more.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Nella's Amazing Adventure/Castlehaven Wrap Battle : Nella and her friends get lost in Minatori's maze. Miscommunication between Nella and Garrett causes their invention at the Royal Science Expo to go wrong.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: The Unicorn of the Lake/Trinket's Toy Trouble : After Trinket's horn is bent in an accident, Nella helps her find a wise unicorn to fix it. Nella and Trinket go on a quest to retrieve Trinket's childhood toy when she accidentally gives it away.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Tricks of The Trade/The Taste Race : When the wicked wizard steals Garrett's knightly trading cards before the big trading convention, Nella is determined to get them back. Nella and Trinket compete to make the best ice-cream.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: A Very Clothes Call/Dragon Taggin' : Nella and the gang must avoid getting their clothes dirty before a fancy party, but it proves harder than it sounds. Nella accompanies Snowpuff the dragon on a quest to find a legendary wishing well.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: The Duke of Sparkleburg/A Royal Cliffhanger : Nella and her friends are invited to a party in the mysterious kingdom of Sparkleburg but no one knows where it is! When Blaine finds himself in peril on a class climbing trip, it's up to Nella to help him!

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Quest in The Castle/Cute Critter Watching : When bad weather ruins their plans, Nella and her friends go on a quest inside the castle. During a cute critter watching trip, Olivia causes big problems by feeding a Chompling lunch.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: The Day The Music Stopped/The Clod Couple : When Badalf the wicked wizard takes Nella and Olivia's musical instruments they have to work together to get them back! Clod moves in with Trinket whilst his stable undergoes roof repairs.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Frozen Trinket/Anything For A Friend : When Trinket is mysteriously "frozen" at the Castlehaven Carnival, everyone blames Badalf.Nella embarks on an adventure to find rare ingredients for Trinket's special nail polish.

programme.title: Nella the Princess Knight
programme.desc: Queen Mom's Day/Dragon Playdate Disaster : Nella goes on a quest for Bling Berries in the Murkberry Mines, so she can make her mom's favorite pancakes for breakfast! Nella and Blaine must find three baby dragons when they go missing from a play-date.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un Truc Qu'on Peut Faire Avec le Doigt : Cartman décide de mettre à exécution le rêve qu'il vient de faire : monter un groupe de musique avec les autres garçons pour gagner '10 millions de dollars'.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les handicapés vont-ils en enfer? : Le Pasteur décide de parler de l'enfer. Il fait alors peur aux enfants en leur disant que s'ils ne sont pas de bons chrétiens, ils périront dans les flammes de l'enfer. Les enfants, décident alors de devenir de bons chrétiens.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Probablement : Dans l'épisode précédent, les garçons découvrent le Pasteur en plein acte sexuel dans son église. Cartman décide de prendre les choses en main afin de remettre dans le droit chemin tous les enfants de la ville.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les cathos, c'est chaud : Le père Maxi propose aux enfants de partir pour une croisière en compagnie de prêtres et d'évêques venus de tous les pays. Mais Randy raconte qu'il a entendu aux informations que les prêtres faisaient subir des mauvais traitements aux enfants.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Bérets Gratos : Les gamins en ont marre que les scénaristes retouchent leurs films avec des images de synthèse ou en éditant les images ou les mots choquants.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les seins de Bebe mettent en danger la société : La puberté fait irruption à South Park: Barbara a des seins qui poussent et les garçons ont un comportement des plus bizarres.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les enlèvements d'enfants, c'est pas marrant : Les parents sont victimes de la psychose de l'enlèvement. Au fil des infos, ils apprennent que leurs enfants peuvent être enlevés par eux-mêmes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Une échelle pour aller au ciel : Pour profiter d'une razzia de bonbons, les gamins sont contraints de retrouver Kenny au ciel pour récuperer un ticket de la plus haute importance.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le retour de la communauté de l'anneau des deux tours : Une nuit de folie, où les gamins passionnés par Le Seigneur des anneaux vont entretenir un quiproquo terrible à propos d'un film pornographique substitué à une copie du Seigneur.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le camp de la mort de tolérance : Les parents veulent sauver leurs enfants de la spirale de l'intolérance. En même temps Mr Garrison en fait peut-être trop. Et une pauvre gerbille vit un road movie passionnant dans les entrailles de Mr Esclave.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Plus Gros Connard de l'Univers : Chef et Mme Cartman décident de purger Eric de l'âme de Kenny. Pendant ce temps Stan tente de prouver que John Edward est un imposteur. Les voies de la solution s'avèreront d'ordre stellaire.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mon Futur Moi et Moi : Un homme se présentant comme le Stan Marsh du futur arrive à South Park. Le Stan du passé est littéralement effaré de voir qu'il tombera dans une telle déchéance.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La Chute du traîneau rouge : Cartman est très tendu. Il a commis trop de mauvaises actions pour espérer avoir des cadeaux à ce Noël. Il tente alors de se racheter en convaincant le Père Noël d'apporter Noël en Irak.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: I'm a Little Bit Country : La sonde anale de Cartman est réactivée. Les garçons se retrouvent dans l'espace et ils ont une mission très, très importante: Sauver la terre!

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les gangs de Denver : Timmy aide Jimmy à former un club composé d'autres enfants handicapés de naissance. Ils sont heureux de découvrir qu'un groupe de ce genre existe déjà.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Papier toilette : Cartman veut faire une crasse à son prof, qui vient de le punir. Pour se venger, il demande aux garçons de se joindre à lui pour remplir la maison du prof de papier toilette.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Gros Cul et Tête de Nœud : Kyle vient de réaliser un brillant exposé sur la culture hispano-américaine. C'est désormais au tour de Cartman de se lancer dans un discours sur les artistes hispano-américains.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les petits policiers : Les enfants décident de jouer les détectives privés. Leur première affaire consiste à retrouver une tarte à la cerise.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La Cupidité de L'Homme Rouge : Monsieur Broslofsky perd tout son argent dans un casino indien. Les indiens rachètent South Park pour construire une autoroute géante.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: est Gay! : La nouvelle folie 'métrosexuelle' (un show télévisé) envahit la ville de South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Rock chrétien : Suite à un pari avec Kyle, Cartman décide de monter un groupe de rock chrétien avec Token et Butters, dans le but d'obtenir un disque de platine.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Rencontre du troisième âge : À South Park, comme dans tout le pays, les vieux au volant sont considérés comme un fléau. Une loi est votée pour leur confisquer leur permis de conduire. Mais le troisième âge contre-attaque.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Casa Bonita : La mère de Kyle doit emmener ce dernier et ses amis à Casa Bonita, une version mexicaine de Disneyland au Colorado. Au lieu d'inviter Cartman, Kyle lui préfère Butters.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Tout sur les Mormons : Un enfant mormon arrive dans la classe des garçons. Stan est supposé lui casser la figure, mais son père et lui sont soudain fascinés par la religion des nouveaux venus, et leur extrême gentillesse. Stan ne tardera pas à revenir sur son avis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stop clopes : Les garçons sont surpris en train de fumer après avoir vu un spectacle ringard contre la cigarette. Rob Reiner, militant extrémiste anti-tabac, décide de piéger les fabricants de cigarettes avec l'aide des garçons.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Raisins : Stan déprime quand Wendy le plaque. Ses amis l'emmènent alors au 'Raisins', réputé pour ses hôtesses de bar sexy. Butters tombe amoureux de l'une d'entre elles, et Stan décide de devenir gothique.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Noël au Canada : Les parents biologiques d'Ike reviennent le chercher chez les parents de Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les armes, c'est rigolo : Grâce à un stratagème surfait, les garçons obtiennent des armes ninja. Alors qu'ils jouent, ils blessent leur camarade Butters. Pris dans un dilemme draconien, les garçons décident de le déguiser en chien pour l'emmener chez le véterinaire.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Génial-O : Cartman s'habille comme un robot, s'auto-proclame 'Génial-O' et déménage chez Butters pour découvrir tous ses secrets et les utiliser contre lui.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les stéroïdes ça déchire : Jimmy s'entraîne pour un événement sportif imminent et est déterminé à gagner à n'importe quel prix. Cartman décide qu'il peut facilement remporter la première place contre Jimmy.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La passion du juif : Cartman a vu le film « La Passion du Christ ». Depuis, il est fan de Mel Gibson et de son film. Il veut alors monter un fan-club très spécial.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les Gluants : Des humains de l'an 4035 débarquent à South Park à travers un portail temporel et recherchent du travail.

programme.title: I Love Lucy

programme.title: I Love Lucy

programme.desc: The Boy With His Head In The Clouds/More! : All the kids know that George is smart--so why does he sometimes have trouble reading and writing? Then, D.W. is thrilled to be getting an allowance. At last, she'll be rich and powerful!

programme.desc: Rhyme For Your Life/For Whom The Bell Tolls : While struggling to write a poem for his mom, Binky falls asleep and gets trapped in Verseberg--where it's a crime not to rhyme! And D.W. has lost her voice! For Arthur it's a dream come true--until Mom asks Arthur to take care of D.W.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: The Good Sport/Crushed : When the Athlete of the Year Award doesn't go to Francine, she makes no effort to hide her hurt feelings from the recipient. Arthur can't believe his parents are hiring a babysitter--he's 8 years old, and babysitters are b-o-r-i-n-g!

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Arthur Loses His Marbles/Friday The 13th : When Arthur discovers that Grandma Thora is a marbles champion, he trains with her so he can beat all his friends. Then, Brain doesn't believe in superstitions, so when he has a string of bad luck, he's stunned.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Cast Away/The Great Sock Mystery : Arthur is thrilled when Dad invites him to go fly-fishing for the weekend. But a change in plans forces them to include D.W. Find out once and for all where socks disappear to when Baby Kate and Pal team up to solve the great sock mystery.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Man’s Worst Friend : Man's Worst Friend: In order to make Timmy and his family miserable, Foop replaces Sparky with the Anti-Sparky. When that plan works, Foop decides to make all of Dimmsdale unhappy by replacing everyone's pet with an evil pet.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Whittle Me This/Mayor May Not : Whittle Me This/Mayor May Not: Catman thinks Timmy has been kidnapped. He mistakes Chloe for Catgirl and enlists her help to save Timmy. Timmy wishes Dad was Mayor, but Timmy gets tortured by the paparazzi and risks having his fairies discovered.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Girly Squirrely/Birthday Battle: Transmorphers Versus Unicorns : Girly Squirrely/Birthday Battle: Transmorphers Versus Unicorns: Chloe joins the Squirrely Scouts and saves the troop by helping them get their first merit badge. Timmy and Chloe find out they have the same birthday and compete for the best party.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fair Bears/Return of the L.O.S.E.R.S. : The Fair Bears/Return of the L.O.S.E.R.S.: Chloe’s favorite cartoon characters come to life and brainwash Timmy and Wanda. Timmy’s enemies learn that he is helpless without his fairies and try to destroy him when he’s weak.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: A Sash and a Rash/Fish Out of Water : A Sash and a Rash/Fish Out of Water: Chloe thinks she has a stress-caused rash and wishes to be a slacker, but Dimmsdale falls apart without her. Dad wants to catch a giant fish to win a trophy, but Chloe wishes all the fish could fight back.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Inside The Powell Family Tragedy : Susan Powell, a beautiful mother of two, vanished in 2009. Her husband, Josh, was considered a person of interest & what began as an unsolved mystery tragically ended with the murder-suicide of Josh Powell & their two sons, Charles, 7, & Braden, 5.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bullies Beware Pt. 2 : The conversation heated when Dr. Phil gave self-professed bully Temica RoShawn a reality check about her aggressive behavior. Guests Ross & Lyndy say weeks of bullying culminated in their 15-yr-old son being sexually assaulted.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Charlie Meets His "Fiancee" Face-To-Face Pt. 2 : Dr. Phil continues with Brittany who says dad Charlie is being scammed by his online fiancée "Stephanie" & her roommate "Carina." Charlie hopes to get married when they meet in person. The real women in the photos are on stage & Charlie goes face-to-face!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dirt, Lies And The Internet : Dr. Phil investigates a popular new website that dishes the dirt on non-celebrities. On creator Nik Richie's controversial site, TheDirty.com, people anonymously submit photos & negative comments about anyone in their community, tabloid style.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is My Nigerian Boyfriend Scamming Me? : Josie, 64, says she has met the love of her life, Victor, on Facebook. He’s Nigerian, 30 years younger, she has never physically met him, yet insists it's true love. Dr. Phil took cameras to Nigeria to find Victor, to see if he’s telling Josie the truth.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Our Pregnant, Rageaholic, 18-Year-Old Daughter Is Abusing Our Entire Family! : Stacey & Dan say daughter Tylor, 18, is a rageaholic who is verbally, mentally & physically abusive. They have called the police 30 times, have had Tylor arrested 10 times & now Tylor is 7 weeks pregnant! Can this family join forces for the unborn child?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The Disappearance of Summer Wells Pt. 1 : Summer Wells, 5, vanished from her Tennessee home, June 15, 2021. Parents Don & Candus claim abduction; online bullies say the opposite. Don & Candus meet with Scott Rouse & Greg Hartley, body language experts who work with the FBI, police and military.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Neighbor Feud Erupts With Constant Calls To The Police, False Allegations, Trumped Up Charges, And Threats Of Violence : Jana & Allen say neighbors Maritha & Melanie moved into the neighborhood: police reports, DFS, threats & their 4 dogs bark all hours of the night! Maritha & Melanie point to Jana & Allen, with Melanie being charged with misconduct for mooning a neighbor!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: My Family Slaughtered For My Daughter's Teenage Love: Can A Father Forgive Pt. 2 : Dr. Phil continues his exclusive interview with Erin Caffey, sentenced to two life terms in prison plus 25 years for murders of her mother and brothers in 2008. Part 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: My In-Laws Tried To Kill Me : Ramon’s former in-laws tried to murder him, and he now finds himself in a bitter custody battle with his ex-wife. Plus, multiple women claim they were sexually assaulted by a police officer in San Diego. How can victims move on from painful trauma?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Consumed By Jealousy : Dr. Phil’s guests say the green-eyed monster has affected their marriage. Paula claims loyalty and Mike questions her fidelity. Mike placed listening devices in the home, set up surveillance cameras to follow her, and subjected Paula to polygraph tests.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents Accused Of Murder: Will Julia and Codey Agree To Take The Polygraph Test? Pt. 2 : Dr. Phil continues discussions with Tommy, ex-wife, Julia & new husband, Codey, over the deaths of 19-month-old Darby & 4-year-old Kiera. Dr. Phil enlists forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht to examine the autopsy reports. Polygraph tests are offered.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Help! My Narcissist Ex Is Abusing My Children And Nobody Believes Me : Pamela says she is likely going to jail for not complying with court orders because she refuses to allow her ex, Justin, his court-ordered visitations. Pamela says Justin attempted to drown their oldest daughter in the pool. Justin says they are lies!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Behind The Headlines: The Disappearance Of Caylee Anthony : Caylee Anthony's mom, Casey Anthony, has been named a person of interest in the case of the missing 3-year-old. Many fear the worst has happened. Dr. Phil examines the psychological aspects of the story that continues to grip America's imagination.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: My Ex Is Trying To Erase Me From My Children's Lives Pt.1 : Libby & Brian are at war over custody of their two young children. Get a behind-the-scenes look at what made Dr. Phil consider canceling the show & learn why he refused to allow these exes on his stage! Don't miss the backstage drama on today's Dr. Phil!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Teens Obsessed With Love : Teens are obsessed with love more than ever. Parents are concerned over measures their daughters take to keep a boyfriend. A poll asked teens about extreme behavior, some saying they had sex when the didn't want to. Parents, don't miss these safety steps.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Blacklisted By Mom: Can We Speak To Our Dad Before He Dies : Four adult siblings say they've been blacklisted by their mother from seeing their dying father, a claim their mother vehemently denies. Emotions run high when this fractured family comes together on Dr. Phil’s stage. Can they put an end to the fighting?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Terrorized By My 10-Year-Old : Alisha says her son, Kevin, 10, pushed the family to the limit with violent outbursts. At home, knives and lighters are hidden & siblings lock themselves in their rooms at night. Alisha's says the 'future Kevin' may hurt the entire family or end a life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Multiple Restraining Orders And Fake Births: What's Next? Pt. 1 : Brittany wrote to Dr. Phil devastated to discover that her boyfriend, the man she loves & with whom she is having a baby, leads a double life. But Dr. Phil discovered that Brittany was leaving out important details. What his team uncovered is shocking!

programme.desc: An Estranged Father Finally Confronts His Children Pt. 2 : The outrageous accusations & animosity continues between warring exes Libby & Brian. What happened that prompted Dr. Phil to consider asking Brian to leave and not return?

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Shanghai : Tony travels to Shanghai. Forget the antiquated views you might hold about a communist-run, creativity-devoid State of androids. The modern China is a vibrant, dynamic monument to capitalism.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: The Bronx : The Bronx is burning, became the defining image of New York City in the 70s. Politicians used it as a backdrop illustrate the dire situation in America’s cities while local officials let it burn

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Iran : Few countries have a more contentious relationship with the United States than Iran. In this episode we heads to this Shia Muslim nation to explore a country few Americans have visited since the 80s.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Colombia : Tony will explore several regions of Colombia from the mountains down to the Caribbean coast to the coca leaf growing inlands formerly controlled by drug cartels.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Libya : Libyan hip-hop, Italian restaurants, tribal allegiances and post-war uncertainty in Libya. Bourdain looks at the country through personal stories, food, and the music of anti-Qaddafi rapper expats.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Canada : The two funniest and most brilliant chef/restaurateurs in Canada, Joe Beef's Dave McMillan and Fred Morin, take Tony across Canada by rail.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tangier : Tony explores what Burroughs called "Interzone," where artists sought escape from Western moral prohibitions and the possibilities of great empty spaces. But what is it like now?

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Peru : Tony and his friend, world-renowned chef Eric Ripert, explore the far reaches of indigenous Andes in search of a rare variety of wild cocoa that is said to be the "best" in the world.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Congo : Bourdain looks at the Congo as one of the more industrialized powers in Africa now largely crumbled to nothingness and chaos with Tim Butcher author of Blood River.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Spain : Tony visits Andalucia during Semana Santa – Holy Week – a time filled with great pageantry and excitement. Tony’s longtime DP, Zach Zamboni, currently lives in Granada with his fiancée, Fuen Sanchez.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: New Mexico : New Mexico has the largest Hispanic population per capita in the US. No better way to see the mash-up of cultures that make up this uniquely American State, than by what the people here are eating

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Israel : Israel, the West Bank and Gaza are three locations Tony has never travelled to before.The intense and fraught relationship between these places is hard to understand but Tony will attempt to delve into the lives of those who live here, through their food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Copenhagen : Tony explores Copenhagen, the economic and cultural center of Denmark.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Sicily : Sicily isn’t about fast food or the fast life. It’s about savoring family, life, food and making the most of what you have. Tony will go in search of those foods and their producers and eat his way around the island.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Detroit : Detroit holds a unique place in American history. Few cities have seen such a dramatic rise and fall from economic boom to disparity. Tony explores the past, present and future of the Motor City.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Tokyo : Tony travels to Tokyo in search of the city's dark, extreme underside.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: South Africa : Once Johannesburg was the most dangerous city in the world, but the end of the apartheid has lead to vast changes in the city. Tony visits the Johannesburg suburb of Hillbrow, and discovers the culture and, of course food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Las Vegas : Tony travels to Las Vegas Nevada with his food author friend Michael Ruhlman. Whatever your need, whatever bad behaviour you’d like to display Las Vegas is the place that will allow it... for a price.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Punjab : Tony dives into the state of Punjab, India, starting off in Amritsar.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown
programme.desc: Lyon, France : Tony accompanies world-renowned chef and restaurateur Daniel Boulud as they travel back to Daniel’s hometown of Lyon, France for a pilgrimage of the city’s rich food culture and its legendary chefs.
